data.body: Phase 1 RCA (confirmed before repair): `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py` maps inferred provider `openai` to the ambiguous pydantic-ai target `openai:` and returns explicitly qualified `openai:` model strings verbatim; `src/rebar/llm/model_classes.py::_resolve_target` independently composes the same ambiguous qualifier for class and fallback targets. At runtime, pydantic-ai 1.107.2 `infer_model` parses that provider name and emits `PydanticAIDeprecationWarning` because v2 will reinterpret it as Responses. With that warning promoted to an error, five real OpenAI-compatible provider tests fail at `runner.py:390` or their real-seam helper; the exact same construction with `openai-chat:` creates `OpenAIChatModel` without the warning, ruling out provider construction and test filtering as causes. Compatibility companion: current `ProviderSession` keys both its cfg.base_url builder registration and its per-candidate endpoint-override guard only on `openai`; a direct `openai-chat:` experiment therefore built the stock provider at `https://api.openai.com/v1` instead of the configured loopback endpoint. Both gates must recognize the explicit qualifier or the warning fix would regress endpoint routing/profile behavior. Defect legitimacy: the operator explicitly approved preserving existing Chat Completions semantics and upstream names `openai-chat:` as that stable contract; future Responses migration is separately tracked by `upbeat-illadvised-springtail`. Caller sweep: `_pai_model`, `_resolve_target`, fallback construction, runner/provider session, capability lookup, pricing qualifier stripping, docs, and eval specs were inspected. Capability and qualifier consumers already recognize `openai-chat`; only the two ProviderSession gates behaviorally depend on the old bare name and are included in repair. No other provider target is to change.
